message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Red Army** – commanded by General Georgy Zhukov (later by Lieutenant‑General Vasily Chuikov at the front lines)
• **German Wehrmacht** – led initially by Field Marshal Friedrich Paulus (who later became an SS officer), supported by elements of the Afrika Korps under Erwin Rommel’s command structure during earlier phases of Operation Barbarossa. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad**, which today is known as **Volgograd**, situated along the western bank of the Volga River in southwestern Russia. | *Key points:* - The battle took place from August 1942 to February 1943. - It marked one of the largest urban battles in history and turned into a decisive turning point on the Eastern Front, halting German advances toward the Caucasus oil fields.
